hook.name: VortaHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for Vorta pools that gates trading behind a governance enable switch, a scheduled launch time, an optional external market status check, and a Merkle-proof allowlist during a configurable early access window. It charges a linearly decaying dynamic LP fee from launch down to a base fee, and collects a protocol fee in the unspecified currency on every swap via afterSwap delta return. Maintains a per-pool TWAP oracle with daily checkpoints.
